info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be angry, to burn, to become hot, to envy, to glow, to shine, to perform penance,to heat, to suffer pain,to hurt

entries.artha_hindi: saMtapta honA, jalanA, jalAnA, tapta karanA

examples: 'pratapantamivAdityaM rAjye sTitamarindamam' (rA॰2.105.9). uBayatra praSabdaH prakarze'narTako vA.
'pratapaM jyotizA tamaH' (f॰9.108.12). aqaBAvaSCAndasaH. prAtapaM prakarzeraRAdIpayam udajvalayam ityarTaH.
sa pratApaH praBAvaSca yattejaH kozadaRqajam ityamaraH.
'divApi mayi nizkrAnte santapyete gurU mama' (sAvitryu॰5.83). santapyete=dUyete=duHKyataH.
'yadataptaM praRamati na tatsantApayantyapi. yacca svayaM nataM dAru na tatsantApayantyapi..' iti ca tatrEva pAWAntaraM mAtfkAsu.
'santaptAyasi saMsTitasya payaso nAmApi na SrUyate' (Bartf॰2.67). santaptam=atyuzRam=prajvalat.
'mahadezAvatapati carantI gozu gOrapi' (aTarva0 (12.4.39). avatapati=avo'DaH tapati saMtaptaM karoti.
'avatapte nakulasTitaM tavEtat.' (pA0 2.1.47). ityatra vfttAvudAharaRam. kzepe gamyamAne prayogaH. cApalametat, anavasTitatvaM tavEtadityarTaH. atrAvaSabdastApasya nyUnatAmAha. avataptam=Izattaptam.
'nizwaptaM rakzo nizwaptA arAtayaH' (vA0 saM0 1.7.59). niHSezaM taptA ityarTaH. nistapati svarRaM svarRakAraH. punaH punastapatItyarTaH.
'yasyA mamABizekArTaM mano viparitapyate' (rA0 gore0 2.19.3). atyantaM tapyate, saMjvaratItyAha.
'SaM te sUrya Atapatu' (aTarva0 8.2.14). Atapatu BAtu, BAsatAm prakASatAm.
'tadAhurniSocati nitapati varzizyati vA iti' (CAM0 u0 7.11.1). nitarAM tapatItyarTaH.
'uttapati svarRaM svarRakAraH' (pA0 1.3.27) sUtre vfttiH. uttapate raviH. uddIpyata ityarTaH. uttapate pARim. uttapate pfzWam. tapatItyevArTaH. nArTa udA.
'aniSaM nijErakaruRaH karuRaM kusumezuruttapati yadviSiKEH' (SiSu0 9.67). uttapati santApayati pIqayati kadarTayati.
'pratyUhaH sarvasidDInAmuttApaH praTamaH kila' (hitopa0 3.45). uttApaH santApaH KedaH saMjvaraH.
'tasmAt kimaBitapyantaM vAkSarErupakfntasi' (BA0 droRa0 151.27). aBitapyantaM duHKyantam dUyamAnam.
'aBitaptamayopi mArdavaM Bajate kEva kaTA SarIrizu' (raGu0 8.43). aBitaptam uttaptam. santaptam. samyak tApaM prAptam.
'indrAvaruRAvaByA tapanti mAGAnyaryo vanuzAmarAtayaH' (f0 7.83.5). aByAtapanti sarvato bADante. aGAni kartfRi.
'yadi dattvA varO rAjanpunaH pratyanutapyase' (rA0 2.12.36). anutapyasa ityevArTaH. pratirnAntaramarTe karoti.
'taM SApamanusaMsmftya paryatapyata BfSaM tadA' (BA0 Adi0 182.26). paryatapyata duHKito'Bavat, durmanA aBUt.
'ke svIkftA na vizayAH paritApayanti' (hitopa0 3.116). paritApayanti BfSaM duHKayanti.
'prasakte nirvARe hfdaya paritApaM vahasi kim' (mAla0 3.1). paritApo vyaTA vedanA.
'AhitAgniScedupatapet' (ASva0 gf0 4.1.1). upatapet=upatapyeta, upatapto rugRaH syAt, AmayaScettaM vindet.
'sa kiM mAmetadupatapasi yo'hamanena na prezyAmi' (CAM0 u0 3.16.7). upatapasi rujasi sAmayaM karozi, akuSalinaM sampAdayasi mAndyaM me janayasi.
'yadi dIkzitasyopatapet' (Sa0 brA0 12.3.5.2). yadi dIkzitasya sato yajamAnasya SarIrAvayave rujA syAdityAha.
'mAnasena hi duHKena SarIramupatapyate. ayaHpiRqena taptena kumBasaMsTamivodakam' (BA0 vana0 2.25).. upatapyate rujyate, uzRI Bavati.
'upataptodakA nadyaH palvalAni sarAMsi ca' (rA0 2.59.5). upataptodakAH SuzkodakAH.
'tAnIzad ivopatapya' (Sa0 brA0 2.5.2.14). tAnatuzAn yavAn kiMcitsozmaRaH sampAdya.
'vivakzitaM hyanuktamupatApaM janayati' (SA0 3). upatApa ADiH, mAnasI vyaTA.
'upatApI vasIyAnBUtvA'nnamicCati' (Sa0 brA0 8.5.2.1). upatApI upatApavAn, rugRaH, AturaH.
